The '''Blind-band hypercomm transmitter''' was a type of [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] used for covert communication.

Exceptionally difficult to detect and even harder to trace, the blind-band hypercomm transmitter was used when stealth was paramount. Blind-band hypercomm transmitters were used extensively on the [[LightStealth-18 Reconnaissance Ship]], a ship noted for its ability to hide itself even while actively scanning and transmitting.<ref name="ECLIPSE"/>

*''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''
